instruction: Import markdown notes in the "~/documents/personal/personal_notes/" directory of my file system to my Simple Note account. Each markdown file should become a separate note in the Simple Note account. The title of each note should be taken from the name of the source file (excluding the directory path and file extension), replacing underscores in it with blank spaces.
notes: The number of markdown files is only known at runtime; the problem uses two placeholder markdown files (md-file-1, md-file-2) plus one non-markdown entry (readme-txt) to show the filter. Instantiate one file/title/content/note object per .md entry returned by show_directory (and extend the pairwise-distinct note parameters of supervisor-complete-task accordingly). show_directory asserts (directory-listed d), which licenses show_file on each listed file; show_file asserts (file-read f); create_note requires the file to be markdown and read, and uses the statically mapped title (file basename without extension, underscores -> spaces) and content. Only simple_note.Note records are created; no notes are updated or deleted, matching the evaluation. complete_task takes no answer (not a question); its two note parameters are task records used only to express the goal conjunction, and it must be the last action.
